steps: Lightly toast the 2 slices of soft white crustless bread if desired.
Spread 1 tbsp cream cheese on one slice and 1 tbsp jam on the other.
Layer 1 slice thin-sliced ham between the bread slices.
Cut the waffle in half.
Spread 1 tbsp jam between the two halves and wrap in foil.
Cut the waffle in half.
Spread 1 tbsp chocolate hazelnut spread between the two halves and wrap in foil.
Cut the waffle in half.
Spread 1 tbsp peanut butter between the two halves and wrap in foil.
Unwrap the stroopwafel.
Consume as is, or warm gently to soften the caramel filling.
Unwrap the coconut macaroon.
Eat it.
Portion 30 g mixed dried fruit into a pocket or small bag.
Flake 40 g canned tuna into a bowl.
Combine with 1 square (~80 g) cooked short-grain white rice.
Drizzle 1 tsp soy sauce over and mix gently.
Remove the energy bar from packaging.
Consume it.
Open the package of cookies.
Eat 2 cookies.
Lightly toast 2 slices of soft white crustless bread.
Spread 1.5 tbsp jam onto both slices and press together.
Remove 1 square (~65 g) of pre-made rice cake cooked with sugar and coconut oil.
Peel 1 medium banana.
Tear open 1 packet (32 g) almond butter and dip or spread onto banana slices.
Pour 1/3 cup (~45 g) trail mix into a bag or bowl.
Portion 1/2 cup (~60 g) roasted chickpeas into a container or bag.
Unwrap the protein bar and eat.
Portion 1/4 cup (~60 g) hummus into a container.
Cut 1 cup carrot and celery sticks and pack alongside the hummus.
Heat 1 cup (~155 g) pre-cooked edamame if warm serving is desired.
Season with salt to taste.
Lay 2 plain rice cakes on a flat surface.
Flake 60 g canned tuna and distribute evenly over the rice cakes.
Lay 2 plain rice cakes on a flat surface.
Layer 60 g turkey slices evenly over the rice cakes.
Lay 2 plain rice cakes on a flat surface.
Spread 3 tbsp hummus evenly over the rice cakes.
Lay 2 plain rice cakes on a flat surface.
Spread 1/4 cup (~60 g) ricotta cheese evenly over the rice cakes.
Toast 1 slice of white or whole-wheat bread.
Spread 1.5 tbsp nut butter onto the hot toast.
Portion 30 g beef jerky and 30 g dried apricot or mango into a bag.
Boil 2 eggs for 10 minutes ahead of travel.
Cool, peel, and pack in a container.
Peel 1 medium banana.
Spread or dip 1.5 tbsp nut butter onto banana slices.
Toast 1 slice of bread.
Spread 1.5 tbsp nut butter onto the hot toast.
Cook 1/2 cup dry oatmeal (~120 g cooked) in water or milk for 10 minutes.
Stir in 1/2 cup mixed berries.
Top with 1 tbsp chopped walnuts.
Lay 2 plain rice cakes on a flat surface.
Spread 2 tbsp nut butter evenly over the rice cakes.
Boil 1 egg for 10 minutes ahead if not pre-made.
Peel and halve the hard-boiled egg.
Peel 1 medium banana.
Toast 1 whole-wheat English muffin and assemble together.
Brew 1 cup (~250 ml) black coffee.
Peel 1 medium banana and place alongside.
Cook oats in water or milk for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour 1 cup hot porridge into a bowl.
Slice or leave whole 2 slices of white bread.
Peel 1 medium orange and divide into segments.
Peel 1 mango and slice into 1 cup (~165 g) pieces.
Pour 1 cup (~245 g) plain yogurt into a bowl.
Portion 1 cup (~150 g) roasted breakfast potatoes into a bowl.
Boil potatoes until tender, then halve 1/2 cup (~90 g).
Season with 1 pinch salt.
Toast 2 slices of white bread lightly.
Spread 1.5 tbsp peanut butter on one slice and 1.5 tbsp jam on the other.
Press the slices together.
Heat a pan with a light coating of oil or butter.
Toast 2 slices of white bread in the pan until golden, then add 2 slices cheese to melt between them.
Portion 1 handful (~40 g) gummy bears into a bag.
Unwrap 1 square (~30 g) dark chocolate (72%+).
Eat it.
Pour 1 cup (~240 ml) flat cola into a cup or bottle.
Pour 1 cup (~240 ml) ginger ale into a cup or bottle.
Pour 1/2 cup (~120 ml) pickle juice into a small cup or bottle.
Heat 1 cup (~240 ml) beef broth gently on a stove or microwave.
Pour into a cup and consume warm.
Prepare instant ramen noodles according to package directions.
Pour 1 cup (~190 kcal) cooked noodles into a bowl.
Spoon 1 cup (~225 g) plain cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with 1/2 cup mixed berries and 1 tbsp chopped walnuts.
Spoon 1 cup (~225 g) plain cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with 1/3 cup mixed berries, 1/2 banana (sliced), and 1 tsp honey.
Spoon 1 cup (~225 g) plain cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with 1/2 cup cubed cantaloupe.
Spoon 1 cup (~225 g) plain cottage cheese into a bowl.
Chop and fold in 1/2 cup cucumber and 1/2 cup tomato.
Sprinkle 1 tbsp fresh dill or chives on top.
Spoon 1 cup (~225 g) plain cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with 1/2 cup mixed berries and drizzle with 1 tsp honey.
Spoon 1 cup (~245 g) plain Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with 1/2 cup mixed berries.
Pour 1 cup (~240 ml) chocolate milk into a glass.
Boil 2 eggs for 10 minutes, cool, and peel ahead of time.
Toast 1 slice of bread.
Arrange the hard-boiled eggs and toast on a plate.
Layer 60 g turkey slices on a plate.
Add 1 cup (~92 g) grapes alongside.
Remove 1 small bag (~30 g) cottage cheese chips from packaging.
Eat them.
Spoon 1 cup (~225 g) plain cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with 1/2 cup cubed pineapple.
Scramble 2 eggs in a pan until just set.
Spoon 1/2 cup (~110 g) plain cottage cheese into a bowl and top with the scrambled eggs.
Squeeze or spoon the fruit puree from 1 baby food pouch (~100 g).
Cook 80 g rolled oats in 300 ml water or milk for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Slice 1 banana and stir into the hot oats with 1 tbsp peanut butter.
Top with 1 tbsp honey and a pinch of salt.
Toast 2 slices of bread.
Spread 1.5 tbsp peanut butter on the toast.
Slice 1 banana and layer on top, then drizzle with 1 tsp honey.
Toast 3 slices of white bread.
Spread 3 tbsp jam across the toast.
Serve with black coffee or tea.
Toast 1 plain bagel.
Spread 2 tbsp jam and 1 tbsp honey on the bagel.
Slice 1 banana and serve alongside with 250 ml orange juice.
Toast 1 bagel lightly.
Spread 1.5 tbsp almond butter on the bagel and drizzle with 1 tsp honey.
Toast 1 bagel and spread 2 tbsp peanut butter on it.
Shake 1 scoop protein powder in 300 ml milk to make a shake and serve with coffee.
Flake 200 g cooked white rice into a bowl.
Slice 1 banana and 1/2 avocado into the rice.
Season with a pinch of salt.
Place 200 g cooked short-grain rice in a bowl.
Wrap with 1 sheet of nori.
Drizzle 1 tsp tamari and 1 tsp sesame seeds over, season with a pinch of salt.
Pour 70 g puffed rice cereal into a bowl.
Add 250 ml milk.
Top with 1 sliced banana and drizzle with 1 tbsp honey.
Pour 50 g wholegrain cereal or muesli into a bowl and add 250 ml milk.
Toast 1 slice wholegrain bread and spread 1 tbsp jam on it.
Slice 1 banana and place alongside.
Spread 1.5 tbsp peanut butter and 1.5 tbsp jam across 3 white rice cakes.
Pour 1 cup puffed corn cereal into a bowl and add 200 ml almond milk.
Toast 2 slices of bread, spread 2 tbsp jam on them, and press together.
Layer 80 g cooked chicken breast between 2 other slices of bread.
Serve with black coffee.
Toast 2 slices of bread lightly.
Spread 2 tbsp cream cheese on one slice and 1 tbsp quince jelly or jam on the other.
Layer 20 g feta cheese between the slices and serve with black coffee.
Toast 80 g millet in a dry pan for 2 minutes, stirring.
Add 300 ml water, bring to a simmer, and cook for 10 minutes until tender.
Stir in 30 g chopped dried apricots, a pinch of cinnamon, 1 tbsp honey, and salt.
Bring 250 ml water to a boil and add 80 g buckwheat groats.
Simmer for 12 minutes until tender, then drain.
Stir in 1 tbsp honey, 80 g berries, and a pinch of salt.
Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a pan.
Scramble 2 eggs until just set, season with salt and a few drops of tamari.
Serve over 200 g cooked white rice.
Heat whole milk (200 ml) with black tea to make chai, add sugar (2–3 tsp).
Warm or cook 2 chapati if desired.
Serve the chai with the chapati and 1 banana.
Stir 80 g millet or maize flour into 400 ml boiling water, stirring constantly to avoid lumps.
Simmer for 8 minutes, then stir in 100 ml milk, 1–2 tbsp sugar, a pinch of salt, and a squeeze of lemon.
Toast 2 slices of wholegrain bread.
Warm 1 tin (400 g) baked beans in a pan and pour over the toast.
Season with black pepper.
Pour 250 ml milk into a bowl.
Add 4 Weet-Bix and let soak for 30 seconds.
Top with 1 sliced banana and drizzle with 1 tsp honey.
Cook 70 g rolled oats in 300 ml water for 5 minutes.
Stir in 1/2 cup stewed peeled apple, a pinch of cinnamon, 1 tsp honey, and salt.
Blend 150 g frozen mango, 1 banana, 300 ml oat milk, a handful of spinach, and 1 scoop plant protein until smooth.
Pour into a glass and drink immediately.
Pour 70 g crunchy oat-cluster cereal into a bowl.
Add 250 ml milk and stir in 1 tbsp Nutella.
Top with 1 sliced banana.
Layer 3 slices wholegrain rye bread with 40 g thin slices of brunost (brown cheese), 1 tbsp strawberry jam, a thin scrape of butter, and cucumber slices.
Boil 1 egg for 10 minutes, cool, and peel ahead of time.
Arrange 2 slices rye bread on a plate with 60 g smoked salmon, the boiled egg, dill, cucumber slices, and a lemon wedge.
Toast 3 slices of crusty bread lightly.
Grate 1 ripe tomato and season with salt.
Top the toast with the grated tomato, 1 tbsp olive oil, and 40 g jamón serrano, then serve with coffee.
Toast 1 bagel lightly.
Spread 2 tbsp cream cheese on the bagel.
Layer 60 g smoked salmon, red onion slices, capers, and a squeeze of lemon.
Toast 2 slices of sourdough.
Spread 200 g cottage cheese on one slice, then layer 1 sliced tomato on top.
Drizzle 1 tbsp olive oil, black pepper, and fresh basil on the other slice.
Spoon 250 g Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with 1 tbsp honey, 25 g walnuts, 2 fresh figs (or 3 dried figs), and a pinch of cinnamon.
Spoon 250 g full-fat Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with 1 tbsp chia seeds, 25 g almonds, 40 g blueberries, and a pinch of cinnamon.
Toast 3 slices of bread.
Mash 1 avocado with salt and pepper, spread on one toast slice.
Pan-fry or poach 3 eggs, arrange on the avocado toast, and crumble 20 g feta and a handful of spinach on top.
Slice a 250 g sweet potato lengthways and roast at 400°F for 12 minutes until tender.
Mash 1/2 avocado with salt and pepper and spread on the sweet potato.
Top with 1 fried egg and a sprinkle of everything-bagel seasoning.
Microwave 300 g sweet potato for 8 minutes until tender, then halve and place in a bowl.
Spread 1.5 tbsp almond butter on the sweet potato.
Top with 1 sliced banana, a pinch of cinnamon, and a pinch of salt.
Place 200 g cooked short-grain rice in a bowl.
Stir in 1 pack (45 g) natto with its tare sauce and 1 tsp tamari.
Top with 1 chopped scallion and nori strips.
Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a pan and sauté 150 g bok choy or spinach until tender.
Fry 1 egg and place on top of 200 g cooked rice in a bowl.
Top with 80 g cooked chicken, the sautéed greens, 1 tbsp tamari, and a few sesame oil drops.
Warm 150 g cooked black beans in a pan.
Heat 150 g cooked white rice separately.
Fry 1 egg, warm 1 corn tortilla, and combine in a bowl with 2 tbsp salsa and 1/4 avocado.
Prepare 1 large arepa from pre-cooked corn flour (100 g), water, and salt according to package directions, then split open.
Scramble 2 eggs and place inside the arepa with 40 g mozzarella or queso fresco and avocado slices.
Heat a light coating of butter in a pan over medium-high heat.
Cook 80 g hydrated tapioca starch (goma) as a thin crepe for 2 minutes per side.
Fill with 40 g mozzarella or queijo coalho and 1/2 sliced banana.
Pan-fry 100 g tempeh over medium heat until golden, about 5 minutes per side.
Warm 2 wholewheat pitas and fill with the tempeh, a handful of spinach, grated carrot, mustard, and pickle.
Toast 2 slices of wholegrain toast.
Spoon 250 g cottage cheese into a bowl, top with 150 g pineapple chunks and 1 tsp honey, and serve alongside the toast.
Fry or griddle a pan lightly and form 200 g cooked rice combined with 2 beaten eggs, 100 g flaked canned salmon, scallion, and 1 tsp tamari into small cakes.
Cook until golden, about 3 minutes per side.
Pour 90 g gluten-free sorghum or rice cereal into a bowl.
Add 250 ml hazelnut or oat milk and top with 1 tbsp pecan or almond butter and a handful of blueberries.
Scramble 2 eggs in a pan.
Toast 2 slices of white bread.
Combine on a plate with a small bowl of porridge, 1 banana, and 250 ml orange juice.
Lay 1 large wholewheat tortilla flat.
Spread 2 tbsp peanut butter across it, add 1 sliced banana, drizzle with 1 tsp honey and a pinch of cinnamon, then roll tightly.
Chill 200 g cooked quinoa ahead of time, then place in a bowl.
Add 150 ml oat milk, top with 100 g blueberries, 1 tbsp chia, 1 tbsp maple syrup, and 1 tbsp pumpkin seeds.
Boil 250 g potatoes until tender, drain, and cut into chunks.
Toast 2 slices of white bread and fry 2 eggs.
Assemble potatoes, toast, eggs, 1 banana, and sweet chai on a plate.
Heat 400 ml milk in a pan and slowly stir in 80 g fine semolina to avoid lumps.
Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring regularly, then stir in 1 tbsp honey, a pinch of salt, and 1 tsp butter.
Slice 1 banana and serve on the side.
Toast or warm 1 large bolillo or crusty roll (halved) if desired.
Spread 200 g refried beans on the halves and top with 40 g cheese, then broil or heat until cheese melts.
Top with 4 tbsp pico de gallo.
Mash 150 g roasted sweet potato and place in a bowl.
Cook 40 g rolled oats in water for 5 minutes and stir in.
Top with 150 g cottage cheese, a pinch of cinnamon, and a pinch of salt.
Heat 200 g baked beans in a pan.
Halve 2 tomatoes and grill or broil until soft.
Sauté 150 g mushrooms in olive oil, toast 2 slices wholegrain bread, and combine on a plate with a handful of spinach.
Boil 120 g dry pasta until tender, then drain.
Toss with 1 tbsp olive oil and 20 g parmesan.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Warm a microwave white rice pouch (250 g) according to package directions.
Shred 250 g rotisserie chicken.
Toss pre-washed salad (100 g) with 1 tbsp olive oil, then combine all on a plate.
Cook 150 g maize flour into ugali by slowly stirring into boiling water for 10 minutes.
Heat 200 g cooked red kidney beans.
Sauté 1 diced onion and 2 diced tomatoes in 1 tsp oil to make a sauce and combine with the beans.
Slice 3 slices of dark rye bread and arrange on a plate.
Layer 40 g Gouda or Emmental slices, 200 g quark (sweetened with 1 tsp honey), and cucumber and tomato slices.
Warm 6 baked falafel (~150 g) in the oven or on the stovetop.
Fill 1 large whole-wheat wrap with 80 g hummus, the warm falafel, and fresh cucumber, tomato, and lettuce.
Warm 150 g black or refried beans in a pan.
Place 60 g cheddar between 2 flour tortillas and heat in a skillet until cheese melts and the tortilla crisps slightly.
Serve with 60 g salsa on the side or on top.
Boil 150 g white pasta until al dente, then drain.
Warm 150 g passata in a pan, toss the pasta in it, and top with 20 g parmesan.
Drizzle with 1 tbsp olive oil and season with salt.
Boil 500 ml broth and add 200 g fresh ramen noodles, cooking until tender.
Soft-boil 1 egg (about 6 minutes) and peel.
Sauté 100 g bok choy in a pan, then combine with the noodles, egg, 120 g sliced chicken or beef, and scallions in a bowl.
Cook a 180 g beef patty in a pan until desired doneness, top with 1 cheese slice and 2 bacon rashers, and let cheese melt.
Dress with lettuce and tomato slices.
Serve with a side salad (150 g) drizzled with olive oil.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Cook 200 g ground beef or steak, breaking up the meat, until browned (about 5 minutes).
Add 200 g kale or spinach with 2 minced garlic cloves and sauté until tender, season with salt.
